Name: American Eagle Foundation
Area of interest: Mental health & well-being of young people
Documentation and Requirements:
Organizations that are certified 501(c)3 nonprofits in the United States or are registered charities in Canada are eligible to apply. Individuals, corporations and other entities will not be accepted. The proposal must show that funding will be used to support programming or goals that positively impacts the mental health and well-being of teens and/or young adults to empower authenticity and a better future for all.

Organizations can apply and receive funding once per year. The organization will need to spend the funding and submit a final report before reapplying. Reapplying for funding does not guarantee that you will be awarded.

Area of interest: Improving health and well-being of vulnerable New Yorkers, enhancing equitable access to healthcare, supporting basic needs, strengthening the healthcare workforce, advancing mental and behavioral health, and funding projects that improve health outcomes for underserved populations across New York State.
Documentation and Requirements:
Must be a domestic 501(c)(3) public charity or exempt operating foundation in good standing with the IRS and NYS.
Must primarily serve New York State residents and benefit poor, disadvantaged, or underserved communities.
Applicant organizations should generally have an annual operating budget of at least $750,000 (per typical guidelines).
Projects must align with the Foundation’s mission and meet one of the focus areas and demonstrate capacity to effectively carry out proposed programming.
Non-Catholic organizations are eligible; Catholic ethical principles guide funding but affiliation is not required.

Name: NBCUniveral Local Impact Grant
Area of interest: Youth education/empowerment, next generation storytellers, amd community engagement
Documentation and Requirements:
- Must be an active 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN active for at least one year) or a fiscally sponsored organization (apply through fiscal sponsor)
- Must have been in operation for at least one year
- Revenue must exceed $100,000; total expenses must be between $100,000 and $1,000,000
- Grant request cannot exceed 30% of total expenses
- Must align with one of three focus areas: Youth Education and Empowerment, Next Generation Storytellers, or Community Engagement
- Ineligible if the organization received $10,000+ annually from Comcast NBCUniversal, NBC/Telemundo-owned stations, or related entities in any of the past three years
Only one application allowed per Tax ID across all marke
Grant Amount: No more than 30% of reported expenses
